element543.value_fbdda2d90251: Behind every domain, website or infrastructure are people who work, invest and carry responsibility. That matters: we approach every request with courtesy, explain what we see in plain language and put professionalism ahead of simply closing a ticket quickly.

element549.value_d7b5673257e2: Before proposing a solution, we listen to the context, because the same question can hide very different needs.

element564.value_a9a0d3d30794: Before it became a company, Netsons was a group of friends online.

element565.value_32ee655a9fda: Between 2004 and 2005, Netsons was the name of a Counter-Strike clan founded and led by Domenico De Monte. Friends played to spend evenings together; that community inspired the idea of making the Web accessible to everyone.

element571.value_85f5b7c0fecf: Counter-Strike and evenings spent online: this is where the name Netsons began to take shape.

element576.value_3e0772ab5c8d: One of the first Netsons pages: free Web space, email and databases, with no banners.

element581.value_cffb3f7852c4: Domenico and Walter: from friendship to a project designed to be useful.

element586.value_44c0826ca6eb: The story continues: new generations and the same desire to make digital technology accessible.

element566.value_649be4b644d9: Four images from the Netsons story

element592.value_ab0b719c6e4d: Domenico ‘DoM’ De Monte is the founder and team leader of a group of friends who meet online to play Counter-Strike. Netsons begins as a community and then becomes the desire to build something useful for other people.

element597.value_d2ea97437b03: An idea from DoM becomes a simple, ambitious project: offer Web space free of charge and let anyone publish a website or application online.

element601.value_016d1e6f11fa: Domenico and Walter open the doors

element602.value_48d6c768868f: Domenico De Monte and Walter Roncoroni begin offering free Web space and email. They also personally help people configure websites and applications, with the practical goal of helping others.

element606.value_4da581169bcf: Users ask for a professional service

element607.value_8b743a1c3d24: Many users say the free services already outperform several paid alternatives and encourage the team to take the next step. Professional services launch in 2007. Technology has grown enormously since then, but the original idea remains. And here we are.

element611.value_42ed7ba2221e: An IT provider for more than 200,000 customers

element612.value_e2f5b447fd47: Today Netsons supports more than 200,000 customers with high-level IT services. Domains, hosting, cloud and servers work together in one ecosystem, backed by Italian infrastructure, specialist expertise and professional support. The scale has changed, but our commitment to making technology useful and understandable to people and delivering the best in quality, performance, security and support has not.

element615.value_283d04299b33: BY YOUR SIDE IN EVERYDAY DECISIONS

element616.value_6a843b079f9c: We help you understand what your project needs, and how to grow it.

element617.value_ea501f43f387: Behind every website, application or service are people with different needs. That is why we start by listening: tell us what you want to achieve, and we will help you assess the alternatives and understand which solution suits your business. The conversation continues after you choose, whenever you need to clarify a question, handle a change or plan your next step.

element626.value_481fad5f3e5d: Data, systems and expertise stay close.

element627.value_28f595853f0f: Your services run on infrastructure hosted in Italy and maintained by our specialists. From data centers to storage systems, every component supports the daily work of websites and applications. Here is how these choices and the people behind them come together.

element632.value_dbd3b663edd1: Italian data centers designed for continuity

element633.value_01474176cd40: We host our platforms in Tier IV-certified Italian data centers. Service continuity also depends on protecting the premises and controlling access: less visible aspects that matter just as much as the technology you use every day.

element638.value_1703dc340e03: Websites, applications and data need a solid foundation. We use Dell PowerEdge servers, Intel Xeon and AMD EPYC processors and NVMe storage, combining resources to suit the needs of each service.

element642.value_c40d6d9b3e03: Cloud infrastructure that does not rely on a single component

element643.value_4acbf3ecd8e3: With OpenStack, redundant networks and distributed copies of data, the infrastructure relies on several components working together. This helps distribute workloads and reduce dependence on any single element.

element648.value_f4c09c97734f: Monitoring tools help us spot changes and anomalies. Our technicians and system engineers assess these signals in context and decide how to respond.

element653.value_511edca6bd84: For Netsons, the quality of a relationship shows in the way people describe it.

element654.value_f574128185b8: Feedback helps Netsons understand where it is doing well and where it can improve. We read it as the experience of real people, not as numbers to display.

element658.value_09acd3616eda: Fast, knowledgeable and consistently available support: exactly what you need to work with peace of mind.

element662.value_3405966a6ca3: A reliable service and a well-prepared support team. Every request received a clear, practical answer.

element666.value_089ecf27ba30: Very fast response times. Our web agency has found a reliable and knowledgeable provider.

copy.copy_bbcc3f08c5c18fdc8320: What is a Virtual Private Cloud?
copy.copy_d8a46759011cc900b161: A Virtual Private Cloud, or VPC, is a logically isolated cloud environment in which multiple virtual machines, networks, and services can be organized as a private perimeter. The customer defines addressing, segments, access rules and connections with external locations or systems.
copy.copy_1f5e3274560ed0b685fd: The Netsons VPC is suitable for architectures composed of frontend, database, internal services, balancing and storage, with scalable resources and network control. Isolation improves project order, but security and continuity still require defined identities, firewalls, backups, monitoring and operational responsibilities.
copy.copy_1bd688d2a6e8ebcdec15: Separates environments, roles and data and allows you to build multi-tier applications, hybrid networks and platforms with multiple coordinated workloads.
copy.copy_5acdbfcc89e398121ba7: Subnets, routing, policies, VMs and shared services are designed within a virtual perimeter that can be connected via VPN or controlled access.
copy.copy_6d2f9064cc1557ac6fa8: It is suitable when a single VPS is not enough and network isolation, multiple components, planned growth and architectural governance are needed.

lavora-con-noi_full-stack-developer.structured_1_description: Svilupperai soluzioni e le integrerai con i sistemi Netsons, producendo codice sicuro e ben documentato e lavorando con autonomia, responsabilità e comunicazione costante con il team. Cerchiamo familiarità quotidiana con Git, Linux e shell, esperienza con MySQL o Redis, PHP, Python, JavaScript, CSS e standard Web, oltre a metodo nell’analisi, nel testing e nel troubleshooting. Contratto a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio, RAL tra 30.000 e 40.000 euro commisurata alle competenze, lavoro full remote, notebook e smartphone, sistema operativo a scelta e premi di produzione.

lavora-con-noi_linux-system-administrato.structured_1_description: Gestirai infrastruttura, server e servizi Netsons e fornirai assistenza tecnica di alto livello ai clienti, con autonomia, responsabilità, cortesia e desiderio concreto di aiutare. Cerchiamo almeno tre anni di esperienza presso un hosting, service o internet provider, conoscenza di Linux, DNS, LAMP, mail server e networking, scripting Bash, virtualizzazione o container e un buon inglese tecnico. Contratto a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio, sede di lavoro a Pescara, workstation, premi di produzione e inquadramento commisurato all’esperienza.

lavora-con-noi_linux-system-engineer.structured_1_description: La gestione e lo sviluppo di soluzioni IT saranno l’attività principale, insieme al monitoraggio di server e servizi, al rilascio di nuove funzionalità e all’automazione dei processi di routine. Cerchiamo esperienza in produzione presso un service provider, padronanza di Linux, Ansible, AWX e Git, conoscenza di DNS, LAMP, mail server e networking, scripting Bash, virtualizzazione VMware o Proxmox e un buon inglese tecnico. Contratto a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio, RAL tra 30.000 e 40.000 euro commisurata alle competenze, lavoro full remote, workstation o notebook e premi di produzione.
